description: This file defines an Android BroadcastReceiver subclass named AppUpdateSspReceiver, which listens for app update events and displays a toast message when such an event is received.

classes.name: AppUpdateSspReceiver
classes.description: A broadcast receiver that responds to app update events by showing a toast message.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles the reception of a broadcast indicating an app update, displaying a toast message with update info.
